source_body_oracle.method: Preserve the original CAJ body verbatim, synthesize only Catalog and absent page-tree ancestors from source Parent links and the explicit CAJ page table, let independent MuPDF reconstruct the index for source-body render comparisons. Separately let qpdf normalize its own input and validate that output; its rendering differences are recorded, not substituted for source pixels. This adds no converter-produced page content to the oracle. All renders at 72 dpi RGB; font behavior is scoped to PyMuPDF.
